channel.title: Wire — Security
channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Un-Mused: How a Single Debug Setting Bypassed macOS Security in Meta’s AI Client
item.description: Security researcher Patrick Wardle revealed an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in Meta's Muse desktop client for macOS. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: SourceHut account takeover via build logs (XSS in ansi2html.py)
item.description: A wormable vulnerability allowed anyone able to inject text in a build log on builds.sr.ht (or other instances) to take over accounts who viewed them (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Apple's Two-Tier Encryption in the UK
item.description: Alice and Bill have identical iPhones. Only one gets Apple’s strongest iCloud protection. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Forging 1024-bit RSA signatures in nearly SNFS time
